item.text: The log confirms an ordering bug: `WelcomePacket` is emitted while the session is still in `LOGIN`, so the client interprets a play-state packet as invalid and disconnects before `LoginSuccessPacket` arrives. I’m checking the project’s intended protocol transition and test setup before changing the sequence.

item.text:
Fixed the login packet ordering in [LoginBridge.java](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-yingxizhao-dev-cs2520-projects/40c7aa4c-2adf-44c6-8b63-be3856052b7e/scratchpad/work/ef9c760161/ws/rd-server/src/main/java/com/rdforward/server/bridge/LoginBridge.java:7).

The bridge now:

1. Sends `LoginSuccessPacket` in `LOGIN`.
2. Transitions the session to `PLAY`.
3. Sends `WelcomePacket` in `PLAY`.

This prevents the client from receiving a play-state packet during login. `./gradlew test` passes with 12 tests.
